sections.heading: Purpose
sections.text: Operational qualification shows that the installed product computes what it should on this computer: it evaluates the bundled reference data sets and, if you use them, replays your registered golden journals. Every step below runs one Metrology Maven command and names the field of the qualification record (qual-record/1) that holds its result. Not runnable yet: the command validate.run_oq@1 is specified but is not in this release, so this protocol cannot be executed until a release ships it.

fields.label: System name and installed product version
Installation qualification record this run builds on

sections.heading: Before you start
sections.text: Complete installation qualification first; its overall verdict must be PASS for the same product version. Golden journals are optional: skip the golden steps if you do not use them, and say so in the deviations field.

fields.label: Golden journals used in this run

sections.heading: Steps
sections.text: Run each step in order and write the result and the qualification record ID in the result column. A step passes only when the named record field shows the result its acceptance criterion asks for.

columns.heading: Result (pass or fail) and record ID

cells.acceptance: Every golden journal you rely on is registered, and its ID appears in the goldens list of the record from step oq-verdict.
